speaker: consultant
text: Good morning, this is Elena Ward speaking. How can I help you today?

speaker: customer
text: Hi Elena, my name is Sarah Mitchell. I run a small bakery downtown and a friend recommended you. I wanted to ask about your prices.

speaker: consultant
text: Thank you for calling, Sarah, and please thank your friend for me. I have three main options. The first is a single strategy session, which is ninety minutes and costs one hundred and eighty dollars.

speaker: customer
text: Okay. And what do I get from that one session?

speaker: consultant
text: We focus on one specific problem, for example pricing or staffing. Within two business days you get a written summary with the actions we agreed on.

speaker: customer
text: That sounds useful. What are the other options?

speaker: consultant
text: The second is the Growth Package. That is six sessions over three months. It costs nine hundred and fifty dollars if you pay upfront, or three monthly payments of three hundred and thirty dollars.

speaker: customer
text: And the third one?

speaker: consultant
text: The third is a monthly retainer at six hundred dollars per month. You get two sessions a month plus email support, and I reply within one business day. The minimum is three months.

speaker: customer
text: Honestly, my problem is bigger than one session. Sales have been flat for a year and I am not sure if it is my prices, my menu, or my marketing.

speaker: consultant
text: Then I would suggest the Growth Package. Three months gives us time to look at all three areas, test a few changes, and see real results.

speaker: customer
text: Six sessions over three months. How does it start?

speaker: consultant
text: After we agree, I send you a short questionnaire within twenty-four hours. Then we have a kickoff session within ten days, and five business days after that you receive a written action plan.

speaker: customer
text: I like that there is a plan in writing. I tend to forget things after a meeting.

speaker: consultant
text: Most of my clients say the same thing. The plan is something you can share with your staff as well.

speaker: customer
text: If I pay the nine hundred and fifty upfront, can I pay by card?

speaker: consultant
text: Yes, card or bank transfer are both fine. The invoice is due within fourteen days.

speaker: customer
text: Great. Let's do it. I would like to sign up for the Growth Package and pay upfront.

speaker: consultant
text: Wonderful, Sarah. I will send the invoice and the questionnaire to you today. Could you confirm the best email for you?

speaker: customer
text: It is sarah at mitchell bakery dot com.

speaker: consultant
text: Perfect. You will hear from me this afternoon. I am looking forward to working with you.

speaker: customer
text: Thank you so much, Elena. I feel better already.
